p: The verse states: “But you shall do nothing to the young woman [na’ara]; the young woman has committed no sin worthy of death” … Na’ar, … this is … sodomy. “Na’ara,”

The verse states: “But you shall do nothing to the young woman [na’ara]; the young woman has committed no sin worthy of death” (Deuteronomy 22:26). The word is read as young woman, “na’ara,” but it is written as young man, na’ar. Na’ar, as it is written, this is an allusion to sodomy. “Na’ara,”
this is a betrothed young woman.
